description: The light of the lamps the original marks with a glow (the halo sprites of the cells' street lamps and ceiling lamps), for the modern lighting only (rt_lights, docs/RENDER.md section 10): each glow a drawn cell holds becomes a point light at the glow, with ray-traced shadows and bounce, while the map has no sun (by day the glows are faint halos). A map's gamedata/maps/<map>/lights.json changes it with its own "glows" object, or switches it off with "glows": null. color is linear 0..1, intensity a factor, range and radius (the bulb's size: how soft its shadows are) in metres, drop how far below the glow the bulb sits (metres, positive is lower). A mod patches the file key by key.

glows.description: A warm, weak bulb: the halo already shows the lamp, the light only reaches the ground and walls around it.
